result.detail: The testbench avoids driving one variable from several processes (separate directed and scoreboard counters) to stay clear of Verilator MULTIDRIVEN warnings. It assumes the gate builds with timing support, as the approved idle testbench already relies on # delays. Reset is released 1 ns after a clock edge to avoid the edge race present in the idle testbench. At most four 1 ns read delays follow any edge, so reads never cross the next posedge. The run-0001 evidence belongs to the upstream idle testbench and is cited only as context, not as a run of this testbench.
